proposed_facts.reason: Independently read all cited worker bodies and memmove dispatch. Compiler guards exclude every copying operation outside __MWERKS__; peeling removes at most three bytes, so memmove's >=32-byte contract leaves a positive n>>3 bulk count. Relative alignment remains different after equal pointer advances, making src_offset nonzero. Forward rounding down and reverse neighboring-word loads substantiate possible reads outside the logical source interval. The functionality document agrees with these qualifications and unchanged direction/alignment names. Inherited retention of all 18 existing facts is preserved; no upstream non-retain claims or contradictions require reconciliation, and no deferrals are needed.
